description:
Search NB8 Floral's artificial (silk) flower catalog by flower type, color and keywords.

    Returns matching products with price per pack, stems per pack, price per stem, delivery time,
    free-shipping flag, product link and photo. When nothing matching is listed on the website,
    returns pre-order options (estimated price, lead time on request). When the flower type is not
    recognized, returns the list of flower types in the catalog.

flower_type.description: Flower or greenery type in English, e.g. 'peony', 'rose', 'hydrangea', 'eucalyptus', 'babys breath'. Empty means keyword-only search.
flower_type.title: Flower Type

query.description: Extra keywords matched against product names, e.g. 'sample box', 'bouquet', 'real touch'.
query.title: Query

us_stock_only.description: Only return items in the US warehouse (about 7-day delivery).
us_stock_only.title: Us Stock Only

name: search_products
title: Search NB8 artificial flowers
